about_the_game:
Cast away your stress

Meet your new desktop buddy! Chill & Reel is an idle fishing game that lives peacefully in the corner of your screen. Play as a charming alligator angler enjoying a relaxing day by the water while you work, study, or browse. Designed for office workers and students who need a stress-free companion during their daily grind, Chill & Reel brings the zen of fishing to your desktop without interrupting your workflow.

But this isn't just another idle clicker. We believe the key to a great idle game is giving you something truly worth watching. That's why we've packed the game with rich, detailed animations that make every moment feel alive. It's like having a charming animated short film playing in the corner of your screen.

Animation: The Soul of Chill & Reel

This is what sets us apart. We've poured our hearts into creating a dense, fluid animation system that brings your alligator to life in ways that go far beyond typical idle games. Your character doesn't just sit there waiting—they express emotions, react to their surroundings, celebrate catches, and simply live their best fishing life. Every moment is carefully animated to be entertaining, charming, and worth glancing at. We truly believe that an idle game should feel like a living, breathing show playing on your desktop, not just a static image with occasional movement.

Authentic Fishing Experience

The fishing mechanics are carefully crafted to mirror real-life angling. Experience the anticipation of waiting for a bite, and the thrill of reeling in your catch with responsive gameplay that rewards patience and precision.

Rich Content to Discover

Catch dozens of unique fish species across multiple rarity tiers. Customize your approach with different rods and baits to target specific catches. Explore handcrafted locations from tranquil lakes to vast oceans, each with unique fish populations. Unlock adorable skins and outfits to personalize your alligator companion.

Your Perfect Desktop Companion

Designed for anyone who needs a calming presence during work or study. Optimized to run smoothly without impacting performance, your alligator buddy fishes peacefully in the corner while you focus on what matters. Check in whenever you want, or simply enjoy having them there.

Sometimes the best productivity tool is knowing there's a cute alligator catching fish in the corner of your screen. 🐊🎣
